title: Weighted area formula for a C¹ map injective on an open parameter domain (Simon Ch. 2 (3.2)/(3.5), derived from the Lipschitz area formula)
statement:
Let k, N ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝᵏ be open, and let χ : ℝᵏ → ℝᴺ be of class C¹ on V and injective on V. No rank condition on Dχ is assumed. Then for every Borel set S ⊆ V and every Borel φ : ℝᴺ → [0, ∞]:
∫_{χ(S)} φ dHᵏ = ∫_S φ(χ(z))·normDet(Dχ(z)) dLᵏ(z).
Notation as in the parent: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hᵏ = μHE[k]; Lᵏ = volume; normDet = LinearMap.normDet; Dχ(z) = fderiv ℝ χ z.
lean_statement: ∀ (k N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn k)) (χ : Rn k → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V → InjOn χ V → ∀ S ⊆ V, MeasurableSet S → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → ∫⁻ x in χ '' S, φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z in S, φ (χ z) * ENNReal.ofReal ((fderiv ℝ χ z).toLinearMap.normDet)
